description: Fork of exp183 (val_bpb=1.6284 at 8K, 302M). Single change: weight_decay=0 on LUT weight tensors only (qk_joint, v_lut, out_proj — all TinyMultiHeadLut.weights). Other params keep wd=0.1. Hypothesis: each LUT cell only receives gradient when its anchor pattern is hit, but wd applies every step -> rare-activation cells get decayed faster than they can learn. If that's a real effect, removing wd from LUTs should improve quality. n_steps=8000 for fast signal. Running in parallel with exp190. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
